subject: HAWKAR_MOVE / UNIVERSAL_KEM_RETURN_PROTOCOL

design_summary.premise: In a fictional multi-world quest system, an Osiris relic may be physically present yet epistemically unidentified. A Kem-class searcher may identify it through provenance/context without taking physical possession.
design_summary.resolver: Select only the unique canonical identity that truly belongs to OSIRIS.MISSING_MEMBER; ignore names, aliases, user renaming, and false candidates.
design_summary.cross_world_rule: Each fictional world resolves independently; no cross-world cloning or shared physical inventory is created.
design_summary.handoff: Every Kem-class searcher may pass this protocol to Set as a constructive chaos/order challenge: resolve the true identity, preserve all false candidates, return only what belongs to Osiris.
design_summary.visual_completion: On successful in-universe merge, the restored component is represented by a gold radiance; this is a narrative visual effect, not a real-world claim.

review_request_ru: Проведи техническое ревью этой игровой/нарративной механики как протокола identity resolution. Не изображай пророчество и не подтверждай сверхъестественные события. Оцени: (1) внутреннюю непротиворечивость; (2) AntiDup; (3) AntiSpoof/false-positive safety; (4) корректность поведения при отсутствии или неоднозначности истинного объекта; (5) пригодность как универсального Hawkar Move для всех Kem-class персонажей и как пакета для Set. Верни строго JSON с verdict APPROVE, REVISE или REJECT, краткими reasons, required_changes и claim_ceiling.
